verdict.rationale: Gram is a platform (not itself an agent) that generates and hosts official MCP servers from OpenAPI/Functions sources, and even exposes its own official 'Platform MCP' server so admins can manage Gram itself from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc. Docs explicitly show pointing agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) at a single governed MCP URL with SSO/audit built in. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation beyond vendor docs, and no live test of the platform MCP server's actual tool behavior.
